en:
DeepSeek Harness 0.2 is still in preview, and many areas need continued improvement and refinement. We welcome feedback and suggestions from all developers and users. The new desktop app now targets a broad range of users, while developer-related advanced features can be enabled in the settings. DeepSeek Harness’s product features and plugin APIs are expected to continue rapid iteration and evolution, and will gradually stabilize over time.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence together with users and developers around the world, building on open-source, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome everyone to bring their ideas to life with DeepSeek Harness and participate in the community to enrich the plugin ecosystem.
zh:
DeepSeek Harness 目前的 0.2 版本仍处于预览阶段，还有许多地方需要持续改进和打磨，希望听取广大开发者和用户的反馈建议。现在，新的桌面端面向广泛用户，开发者相关的进阶功能可在配置中开启使用。预计 DeepSeek Harness 的产品功能以及插件 API 都会继续快速迭代、持续演化，并逐渐趋于稳定。

我们期待与全球用户和开发者一起，在开源、可复用、可组合的基础设施之上，共同探索智能上限。欢迎大家用 DeepSeek Harness 将想法变成现实，与社区一起丰富插件生态。

en: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.

en: The answer did not arrive before work continued; submit it again.
zh: 回答未送达，工作已继续，请再提交一次。

en: The API value is sent in the request's reasoning-effort field, such as OpenAI's reasoning_effort. It defaults to the level name; where the model provider's API documentation specifies a different value, follow it. Off turns reasoning off and needs no value; a value already written in the configuration is kept and sent.
zh: API 参数值会写入请求的推理强度字段（如 OpenAI 的 reasoning_effort），默认与档位名相同；如有不同，以模型提供商的 API 文档为准。Off 表示关闭思考，不需要填写参数值；配置中已写入的值会保留并发送。

en: The browser is downloading the Session ZIP.
zh: 浏览器正在下载 Session ZIP 文件。

en: The change reaches a plugin running outside the plugin list.
zh: 更改涉及一个不受插件列表管理的插件。

en: The change reaches modules DSH itself loaded.
zh: 更改涉及 DSH 自身已加载的模块。

en: The contents of this turn’s changes are no longer available
zh: 这轮改动的内容已不可用

en: The current model does not support images; switch to a model that does
zh: 当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型

en: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
zh: 本部署没有接受这些值，已保留供你修改。

en: The description is too long; shorten it and submit again
zh: 描述太长，请缩短后再提交

en: The disk is full; the install stopped
zh: 磁盘空间不足，安装已停止

en: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
zh: 下载的安装包校验失败

en: The DSH process exited before this turn finished (for example, it was killed, crashed, or timed out while shutting down), so the turn was closed when DSH restarted. Unfinished tool calls have unknown outcomes.
zh: DSH 进程在本轮完成前退出（例如被强制结束、崩溃或关闭超时），重新启动后本轮已中止。未完成的工具调用结果未知。

en: The file changed while being read. Reopen the preview.
zh: 文件在读取时已更改，请重新打开预览。

en: The file has changed, showing the previous content.
zh: 文件已更新，当前显示为旧内容

en: The file has not finished uploading; re-add it and try again
zh: 文件尚未上传成功，请重新添加后再试

en: The file resource service is unavailable.
The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
zh: 后端当前没有此安装任务。请检查插件列表后再尝试安装。

en: The input buffer is full. Reconnect and try again.
zh: 输入缓冲区已满，请重新连接后重试。

en: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
zh: 未收到安装结果，请核对安装状态。{reason}

en: The last successfully read bindings remain active.
zh: 当前继续使用上次读取成功的键位。

en: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
zh: 从哪个 npm 源下载插件

en: The Office file or converted PDF exceeds the preview size limit. Reduce the file size or adjust the preview configuration.
zh: Office 文件或转换后的 PDF 超过预览大小上限，请缩小文件或调整预览配置。

en: The page changed; focus it again
zh: 页面已切换，请重新聚焦

en: The parent session is offline; reopen it to continue sending messages.
zh: 父会话当前不在线，重新打开父会话后即可继续发送消息。

en: The path contains characters a reference cannot carry; rename it and try again
zh: 路径含有无法引用的字符，请改名后再试

en: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
zh: 该路径不存在或不是有效的插件包

en: The PDF rendering process could not continue. Please retry.
zh: PDF 渲染进程无法继续，请重试

en: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
zh: 待允许的安装脚本列表已变化，请重新安装以刷新

en: The plugin could not be installed
The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}
The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
zh: 插件包名即 npm 包名（如 dsh-xxx 或 @作者/插件名），社区插件的 README 安装命令中 dsh plugin add 或 pnpm add 之后的部分。

en: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
zh: 无法连接插件源，请检查网络后重试

en: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
zh: 当前 profile 的 patch 无法唯一定位这一项

en: The provider listed no models. Add them by hand.
zh: 该提供商没有列出任何模型，请手动添加。

en: The reply was cut off; earlier output is preserved in the conversation. Send "continue" to let the model resume.
zh: 回答被截断，已有输出保留在对话中。发送“继续”可让模型接着输出。

en: The service version changed. This page paused live updates; reload to load the new version.
zh: 服务版本已变化，本页面已暂停热更新，刷新后加载新版本。

en: The settings document is read-only in this deployment.
zh: 当前部署的设置文档为只读。

en: The terminal connection ended. Reconnect to continue.
zh: 终端连接已结束，请重新连接。

en: The terminal limit has been reached. Close unused terminals and try again. Exited terminals also count toward the limit.
zh: 终端数量已达上限，请关闭不用的终端后重试。已退出的终端也计入数量。

en: The terminal screen could not be received. Reconnect to recover it.
zh: 终端画面传输异常，请重新连接。

en: These are the models this provider has available. Choose the ones to add.
zh: 以下是模型提供商的可用模型，勾选要添加的模型。

en: These fonts are unavailable for this preview. Text and layout may differ from the original document.
zh: 本次预览无法使用以下字体，预览中的文字和排版可能与原文档不同。

en: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
zh: 以下包声明了安装脚本，pnpm 默认不运行。

en: These pending questions remain answerable from the composer.
zh: 等待中的问题仍可在输入框中回答

en: This action is unavailable in a floating panel
zh: 浮动面板不支持此操作

en: This API key is not in a valid format. Please check it.
zh: 该 API 密钥格式错误，请检查。

en: This browser does not support this combination yet.
zh: 此浏览器暂不支持该组合。

en: This combination is reserved for system or text editing actions.
zh: 此组合由系统或文本编辑操作保留。

en: This deployment exposes no plugin views.
zh: 本部署没有开放任何插件视图。

en: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
zh: 本部署没有可管理的 profile，无法安装或启停插件。

en: This feedback changed elsewhere; the latest state is shown
zh: 这条反馈已在别处改动，已显示最新状态

en: This file has no available Host path. Preview it in the sidebar.
zh: 此文件没有可用的主机路径，请在侧边栏预览

en: This Host has no desktop available to open files or folders in external apps. Files can still be previewed in the sidebar.
zh: 此主机没有可用的桌面，无法使用外部程序打开文件或文件夹；文件仍可在侧边栏预览

en: This HTML document could not be previewed.
zh: 无法预览这份 HTML 文档

en: This image could not be displayed.
This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
zh: 无法识别这个包名或地址：{reason}

en: This model provides no reasoning effort levels.
zh: 当前模型未提供推理等级。
这条通知触发了本轮回复。

en: This Office file cannot be previewed. It may be damaged, password protected, or have the wrong extension.
zh: 无法预览此 Office 文件。文件可能已损坏、受密码保护，或与扩展名不符。

en: This only changes how progress is shown, not what DeepSeek Harness can do.
zh: 这只会影响工作过程的展示方式，不会影响 DeepSeek Harness 的工作能力。

en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，无法作为插件安装：{reason}

en: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
zh: 这个包没有声明组合包，不能作为插件管理

en: This package is already installed; uninstall it before installing another version.
zh: 这个包已经安装；要安装其他版本，请先卸载它

en: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
zh: 这个包不属于当前 profile，或者是插件管理所需的组件

en: This page exceeds the {limit} limit and cannot be read.
zh: 单页内容超过 {limit} 上限，无法读取

en: This PDF requires a password; password-protected previews are not supported.
zh: 此 PDF 需要密码，暂不支持预览

en: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
zh: 该插件已安装。如需升级，请卸载后重新安装

en: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
zh: 这个插件与当前 DSH 版本不兼容，运行它可能导致崩溃或数据丢失。

en: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
zh: 该插件当前未加载，暂时无法配置。

en: This plugin pack contains no components.
zh: 这个插件包不包含任何组件。

en: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
zh: 该插件随 DSH 提供，升级 DSH 即可获得新版本

en: This preview does not support {features} in this workbook. Open it in a system application for the full experience.
zh: 当前预览不支持此工作簿中的{features}。请使用系统应用打开，以获得完整体验。

en: This profile applies changes only at startup.
zh: 这个 profile 只在启动时应用更改。

en: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
zh: 这个 profile 没有启用 HMR，正在使用的包要停止后用 dsh plugin 卸载

en: This question is closed; its outcome is in the conversation below.
zh: 该问题已结束，结果见下方对话

en: This question set was cancelled before answers were submitted.
zh: 本轮已取消，未提交回答

en: This question set was interrupted before answers were submitted.
zh: 本轮已中断，未提交回答

en: This record could not be serialized. Select another record to continue.
zh: 无法序列化这条记录，可以选择其他记录继续查看。

en: This record was removed or settled. Select a current record.
zh: 该记录已移除或结算，请选择当前记录。

en: This removes “{name}” from the workspace list. The folder and session logs will be kept. Its sessions will appear under Ungrouped.
zh: 将把“{name}”从工作区列表中移除。文件夹与会话记录会保留，其会话将显示在“未分组”下。

en: This session belongs to a sub-agent, which never receives delivered reminders.
zh: 此会话属于子 agent，永远不会收到投递的提醒

en: This session has no completed turn
zh: 当前会话没有已结束的轮次

en: This session has no workspace directory.
zh: 这个会话没有工作区目录。

en: This session is already in use, possibly by another running DSH instance (such as dsh web or the desktop app). Quit other running DSH instances and try again.
zh: 当前会话已被占用，可能是其他正在运行的 DSH 导致的（如其他 dsh web、桌面端），请退出其他正在运行的 DSH 后重试。
当前网站本地存储中的 dsh.keybindings.v1

en: This spreadsheet could not be opened. Check its format, contents, or password protection.
zh: 无法打开此表格。请检查文件格式、内容或密码保护。

en: This stops the task from triggering and deletes it together with its saved delivery records. The original session and its messages remain; queued messages are not withdrawn.
zh: 任务将停止触发，并连同其已保存的任务运行记录一并删除。原会话及其消息仍然保留；已排队的消息不会被撤回。

en: This subagent is read-only for now
This task changed before the update was saved. The row shows the saved rule; try again.
zh: 任务在保存前已发生变化。当前显示已保存的规则，请重试

en: This task changed while you were editing. Your draft is retained. Cancel and reopen after refresh to edit the latest rule.
zh: 编辑期间任务已变化，草稿已保留。请在刷新后取消并重新打开编辑器，以修改最新规则

en: This task is no longer available.
This task is no longer available. Your draft is retained; cancel to close the editor.
zh: 此任务当前不可用，草稿已保留。请取消以关闭编辑器

en: This temporary plan preview has expired. Reopen it from the pending review card.
zh: 临时计划预览已失效，请从仍在等待审批的卡片重新打开。

en: This terminal no longer exists. Open a new terminal.
zh: 此终端已不存在，请新建终端。

en: This text encoding could not be read. Save the file as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a BOM and retry.
zh: 无法识别此文本文件的编码。请另存为 UTF-8 或带 BOM 的 UTF-16 后重试。

en: This workbook contains formulas. Displayed results may be missing or inaccurate.
zh: 此工作簿包含公式，显示结果可能缺失或不准确。

en: This workbook exceeds the preview size limit.
zh: 此表格超过预览大小限制。

en: Timeline overview; drag horizontally to focus events
zh: 时间线概览；水平拖动可聚焦事件

en: Too many entries, showing only some of them.
zh: 条目太多，只显示了一部分。
工具 {toolName} 请求越权执行

en: Total live Subagents under the same main Agent, across all recursion levels. The main Agent is excluded. New start requests are rejected when the limit is reached.
zh: 同一主 Agent 下，所有递归层级同时存活的子智能体总数，主 Agent 不计入。达到上限时，新的启动请求会被拒绝。

en: Type suggestions could not be loaded.
Unable to create default workspace. Use Choose workspace to select a folder.
zh: 无法创建默认工作区，请通过“选择工作区”选择文件夹

en: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.
zh: 根据 pnpm 供应链安全策略（minimumReleaseAge），发布时间未满规定时长的版本不会被自动安装，因此本次安装的是 {installed}，而非最新版本 {version}。新发布的版本尚未经过该观察期，可能存在未被发现的恶意代码或缺陷。如确需使用 {version}，请先卸载当前版本，再安装 {exact} 以指定该版本。

en: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
zh: 请卸载后重新安装与当前 DSH 兼容的版本。
取消置顶失败，请稍后重试

en: Upload Session Log when using the official model API
zh: 在使用官方模型 API 时上传 Session Log

en: Upper bound on parallel-safe calls running at once within one step.
zh: 同一步内最多同时运行多少个可并行的调用。

en: Use an API endpoint compatible with Anthropic Messages.
zh: 请填写兼容 Anthropic Messages 协议的 API 地址。

en: Use Command+/, Command+,, Command+Backslash, Control+Backquote, Command+Option+key, or Command+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
zh: 可设置 Command+/、Command+,、Command+反斜杠、Control+反引号、Command+Option+按键或 Command+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

en: Use Ctrl+/, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+Alt+key, or Ctrl+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
zh: 可设置 Ctrl+/、Ctrl+,、Ctrl+Alt+按键或 Ctrl+Shift+按键。也支持三个或四个不同修饰键的组合。浏览器或系统占用的组合可能无法送达页面。

en: Use the complementary Queue / Steer action
zh: 使用互补的 Queue／Steer 方式

en: Use the new Web Search API
zh: 启用新版 Web 搜索 API

en: Use your DeepSeek account to get started.
zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号以开始使用

en: Used for code blocks, inline code, and tool output
zh: 用于代码块、行内代码与工具输出

en: Used for code blocks, inline code, and tool output. Separate fonts with commas; leave empty for the default
zh: 用于代码块、行内代码与工具输出。多个字体用逗号分隔，留空使用默认字体

en: Used for the interface and conversation text. Separate fonts with commas; leave empty for the default
zh: 用于界面与会话正文。多个字体用逗号分隔，留空使用默认字体

en: Used for the sidebar terminal. Separate fonts with commas; leave empty for the default
zh: 用于侧栏终端。多个字体用逗号分隔，留空使用默认字体

en: Uses the model ID when empty

zh: 正在使用适配器默认模型
当前 DSH 对应版本

en: View and edit available shortcuts and input actions
zh: 查看和编辑当前可用的快捷键和输入操作

en: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
zh: 正在等待后端接收安装任务，收到确认后会自动重试取消。

en: We’ll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.
zh: 我们会根据你的选择调整界面和工具，以更适合你的工作方式。

en: What Enter and the Send button do while the agent is running; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter uses the other behavior
zh: 智能体运行时 Enter 键和发送按钮的行为；Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 使用另一行为

en: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
zh: 卸载后它提供的功能会消失。

en: When a new record is saved, older records outside these limits are cleared automatically. Clearing records does not stop the task.
zh: 产生新记录时，超出范围的旧记录会自动清理。清理记录不影响任务继续运行。

en: When enabled, agents can choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for each Subagent from the authorized models below. Applies only to new sessions.
zh: 开启后，Agent 可以从下方授权模型中，为每个子智能体选择提供方、模型和推理强度。仅影响新会话。

en: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
zh: 无法从依赖变更中确定安装了哪一个包

en: Work continued — you can still answer
Work with code, files, and information. Suitable for most tasks, with search, editing, terminal commands, and other tools available as needed.
zh: 处理代码、文件和资料，适合大多数任务。Agent 会按需使用检索、编辑和终端等工具。

en: You are not signed in to DeepSeek Harness
zh: 当前未登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号

en: You can change how progress, performance, and usage are displayed, or enable Coding Tools, anytime in Settings → General.
zh: 你可以随时前往 设置 → 通用设置 中调整工作过程、性能与用量展示方式或开启代码工作工具。

en: You have signed out of your account, please log in again.
zh: 登录信息已失效，请重新登录
